Restore user-message image rendering when the legacy `renderMessageImages` callback is absent ([#9](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/issues/9)).

- Retain legacy `props.renderMessageImages` support when provided by the host.
- Delegate to the host's reusable `conversation.chat.user.content` factory in a full-width, right-aligned attachment row above the text bubble (and omit an empty text bubble for image-only messages), preserving the native gallery and lightbox on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- Add an async `loadImage` / `loadImage.peek` thumbnail fallback (`ImageThumb`) that handles synchronous cache hits, Promise resolution, session/attachment rebinding, load/decode errors, and unmount when neither `renderMessageImages` nor the content factory is available.

当宿主未提供旧版 `renderMessageImages` 回调时，通过宿主 `conversation.chat.user.content` 工厂在气泡上方独立右对齐行中渲染用户消息图片与原生大图预览（纯图片消息不再渲染空气泡），并为仅提供异步 `loadImage` / `loadImage.peek` 的环境提供缩略图兜底（[#9](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/issues/9)）。

Thanks to [@BrainZombie](https://github.com/BrainZombie) for reporting [#9](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/issues/9) and following up with the async `loadImage` / synchronous `loadImage.peek` diagnosis.

Validation: 49 automated tests (including 25 client image tests and 36 tree assertions), release-tool and npm package checks, and isolated official DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` fresh-boot, restart, and browser/geometry acceptance checks with an offline model. The `v1.3.1` source tag and release are available on GitHub; npm publication of `dsh-plugin-message-edit@1.3.1` is pending manual publish.
